The SDK uses the active window. A menu bar app without a presentable window gets a separate paywall window. Overlay windows follow their host’s size and position; closing the host dismisses the paywall. Escape dismisses modal and drawer sheets. Popup backdrop clicks dismiss the popup. Closing follows the normal paywall lifecycle, feature gating and survey flow.
Full screen means the window’s content area, not macOS full-screen mode. Design paywalls to respond to different aspect ratios. Use

The SDK reports native Macs as

. Mac Catalyst apps report it as before. Native macOS uses an app-scoped UUID persisted in UserDefaults for SDK device identity. It is not Apple’s IDFV and is not sent as an IDFV to attribution partners. MMP install matching is skipped on native macOS because its backend currently supports only iOS and Android. Screen dimensions are in points. Haptics use the trackpad when supported.
